injuries.detail: Mintyukov (lower body) was put on injured reserve Thursday.
Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.
Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.
Terry (hip) was moved from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports.
Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.
out
Kulich has been placed in concussion protocol, per Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Monday.
Lyon (upper body) had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return, the team announced Thursday.
Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.
Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.

out

ir

Nikishin (not injury related) will need some time before he makes his 2026-27 debut, according to Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal on Monday.
